items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 19 September 2026 4:17pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 19 September 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure covers the Norwegian Sea and Iceland, while high pressure near the Azores builds a ridge across the area.


##Wind##

West or Southwest 4 to 6, veering West 5 or 6 this evening, decreasing 4 or 5 later tomorrow morning, then backing West or Southwest 3 or 4.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, falling slight tomorrow afternoon.


##Weather##

Isolated showers at first.


##Visibility##

Mainly good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or Southwest 3 or 4, backing South or Southwest tomorrow evening, then increasing 4 or 5 overnight into Monday. Decreasing 3 or 4 again later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle overnight into Monday, becoming fair later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.
